'''''Crucible''''' is a novel that was written by author [[Troy Denning]] and was released on [[July 9]], [[2013]]. It featured characters such as [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. It is chronologically the last novel in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, formerly the Expanded Universe, before the [[2014]] reboot.
